content.comment_body: Hello, the [product_name] is not transmitting the value of the read parameter. Has anyone encountered a similar issue with [version_no]?

You may be looking for values in the wrong place. The parameter fields under analog blocks show current values only during simulation. For Online-Test mode, you need to check the output fields, which you can view by clicking on the symbol that looks like a pair of glasses.
Thanks for your response. In that case, why am I also unable to see data values after adding inputs and outputs in [product_name] (server)?

I'm not sure. I need more details from you for troubleshooting. I don't have access to your [product_name] program or your [product_name] project setup. The best approach would be to upload both as a ZIP file for review.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are experiencing confusion about live value monitoring in the [company_name] system, especially regarding how value readout behaves in simulation, online testing, and when using the [product_name] as a server. The discussion reveals uncertainty about how parameters are presented in analog blocks depending on the environment, and there is a specific challenge with data display in the server configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect real-time parameter values to be accessible both in simulation and server display using [product_name]. They want consistent and reliable access to current data for effective monitoring and diagnostics.
